senses.gloss:
अंह् अंह् (allied to अङ्घ्), cl. 1. A. अंहते,
हितुम्, to go, set out, commence; to ap-
proach: cl. 10. P. अंहयति, to send; to speak; to
shine. [The rt. अंह् seems to have had originally
another meaning, viz. to press together, strangle; =
Gr. ἄγχω]

अंहति, इस्, f. (probably fr. the preceding rt., said
to be here a substitute for हन्), anxiety, distress,
trouble, illness [cf. Lat. ango]; a gift, (in this sense
also अंहती, f.)

अंहस्, n. (said to be connected with rt. अम्),
anxiety, trouble; sin [cf. अघ, आगस्; Gr. ἄχνυμαι
ἄχος, ἄγος].
—अंहसस्-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of
the perplexity, i. e. an intercalary month.
—अंहस्-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, sinful.
—अंहो-मुच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved.
delivering from distress.
अंहिति, इस्, f. a gift, donation. See अंहति.

अंहु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. strait, narrow; (उस्), m.,
N. of an Asura; (उ), n. anxiety, distress; Pudendum
Muliebre [cf. Gr. ἐγγύς Goth. aggvus; Lat.
angustus, anxius, &c.].
—अंहु-भेदी, f. having
a narrow slit, having the pudendum divided.
अंहुर, अस्, आ, अम्, straitened, distressed; sinful.

अंहूरण, अस्, आ, अम्, distressing, sinful; (अम्),
n. sin, distress.
अंहोयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. troublesome; freed from sin.

अंह्रि, इस्, m. a foot, the root of a tree [cf.
अङ्घ्रि].
—अंह्रि-प, अस्, m. a tree (foot-drinker).
—अंह्रि-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. a part of the foot between
the ancle and the heel.
